title: Python Basics
summary: Learn Python syntax, variables, decisions, and loops by building small practical programs.
outcome: You will finish with a working command-line quiz that you can explain and improve.

title: JavaScript Essentials
summary: Use JavaScript to respond to clicks, update page content, and check simple form input.
outcome: You will build an interactive web page using clear, easy-to-follow JavaScript.

title: Java Fundamentals
summary: Learn Java classes, methods, and collections through a simple student record program.
outcome: You will create a small Java application that stores and displays student records.

title: C# Foundations
summary: Explore C# types, methods, and objects while creating a basic task-list program.
outcome: You will complete a console task list with options to add and review tasks.

title: C++ Starter
summary: Practise C++ functions, vectors, and references through short problem-solving exercises.
outcome: You will build a menu-based score tracker and understand how its data is stored.

title: PHP for the Web
summary: Use PHP to process a form, work with arrays, and create a small dynamic web page.
outcome: You will build a simple feedback page that checks and displays submitted information.

title: Ruby Basics
summary: Learn Ruby methods, arrays, and hashes by creating a small text-based organiser.
outcome: You will make a readable Ruby program that sorts and displays a personal book list.

title: Swift App Basics
summary: Use Swift types, optionals, and functions to prepare for simple iOS app development.
outcome: You will create the working logic for a small habit-tracking application.

title: Kotlin for Android
summary: Learn Kotlin classes, null safety, and collections with examples suited to Android apps.
outcome: You will build the data and logic for a basic mobile shopping-list application.

title: SQL Foundations
summary: Write SQL queries to select, filter, join, and summarise information from a database.
outcome: You will answer a set of practical business questions using clear SQL queries.
